source.title: Perplexity's new Monitor API turns web search from a one-off query into a nonstop watchdog
source.text: Perplexity is launching a Monitor API that searches the web on a schedule and alerts agents via webhook only when relevant changes occur. Its own decision model filters out unimportant results. For Perplexity, the API is part of a broader strategy to stand out from an increasingly interchangeable chatbot business through developer tools. The article Perplexity's new Monitor API turns web search from a one-off query into a nonstop watchdog appeared first on The Decoder .

draft.threads_post:
Perplexity is launching an API that turns web search into an automated watchdog.

The new Monitor API searches the web on a set schedule instead of answering one-off queries. It sends webhook alerts to AI agents only when relevant changes occur. Perplexity uses its own decision model to filter out unimportant results. The tool is part of a strategy to stand out from chatbots.

Would automated search alerts help your AI agents, or cause too much noise?
